hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh issue (comment|edit|close|reopen|label|create)|gh pr (comment|edit|close|reopen|label)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"You are about to modify the PUBLIC GitHub tracker. Did Jonathan explicitly ask you to post this?"}}'; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.md ]] && [[ "$file" != *CLAUDE.md ]] && [[ "$file" != *.claude/* ]]; then echo 'Blocked: Do not create/edit markdown files outside .claude/ directory. Exception: CLAUDE.md files are allowed.' >&2; exit 2; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(\./)?gradlew' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q -- --no-scan; then echo 'Blocked: All Gradle commands must include --no-scan flag.' >&2; exit 2; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(git reset --hard|git clean -fd|git filter-branch)'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive git operation detected. Confirm before proceeding."}}'; fi
echo 'Reminder: Use --no-scan with all Gradle commands. NEVER use gh issue/pr comment on the PUBLIC issue tracker without explicit permission. NEVER commit to main directly.'
